profile.headline: AI/ML Engineer & Python Developer | Data Analytics
profile.positioning: Building production-oriented AI systems with Python, RAG, semantic search, and real-time LLM workflows, with a secondary focus on SQL-led data analysis and business intelligence.
profile.summary: AI/ML Engineer with hands-on experience in Python, generative AI, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, vector search, NLP workflows, and production-oriented AI application development. Built document search and retrieval systems with PyTorch, FAISS, Sentence Transformers, Llama 2, FastAPI, Supabase, and WebSockets, reducing search latency from 45 seconds to under 500 milliseconds and improving semantic retrieval accuracy to 92%+. Alongside AI/ML delivery, applies Python, SQL, Pandas, DuckDB, Tableau, and Streamlit to clean and validate data, perform exploratory analysis, and turn findings into decision-ready dashboards and reports.

experience.title: Software Engineer — Python, AI/ML & LLM Workflows
highlights: Develop and optimize AI-powered document search and retrieval systems using Python, FAISS, Sentence Transformers, and Llama 2, reducing search latency from 45 seconds to under 500 milliseconds.
Improved semantic retrieval accuracy to 92%+ through vector-search optimization, embedding improvements, retrieval-failure analysis, and domain-specific model training.
Design and develop full-stack AI chat applications using Python, FastAPI, React, FAISS, Supabase, WebSockets, and LLM workflows for document-based question answering.
Build end-to-end PDF ingestion and document-processing workflows covering text extraction, semantic search, OCR fallback, and automated report generation.
Structure and validate unstructured document data for reusable reporting workflows while translating stakeholder requirements into business-readable outputs.

experience.title: Data Analyst Intern
highlights: Cleaned, transformed, and analyzed large datasets using Python, Pandas, and SQL, creating reusable data pipelines and structured mappings.
Developed interactive Tableau dashboards to visualize KPIs, trends, and actionable business insights.
Performed exploratory data analysis and data validation to improve data quality and support data-driven decision-making.
Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements, automate reporting, and deliver insights aligned with business objectives.

projects.title: AI Chat Application
projects.short_description: A portfolio-backed AI chat application with authenticated sessions, streaming responses, document processing, and retrieval-augmented generation.
highlights: Built with FastAPI and React, including secure authentication, session management, and real-time response streaming.
Uses a RAG pipeline with FAISS, SentenceTransformers, and Llama models for context-aware answers from domain data.
Includes document processing, Supabase integration, and automated PDF report generation.
projects.source_note: Included as portfolio-backed project evidence; not attributed to an employer.

projects.title: LLM-Powered SQL Query Generator
projects.short_description: A fine-tuned text-to-SQL system that converts natural-language questions into executable SQL through a FastAPI inference service.
highlights: Fine-tuned CodeLlama-7B on 80,000 natural-language and SQL pairs using QLoRA.
Achieved 79% execution accuracy on the Spider benchmark.
Served more than 500 queries per day through a FastAPI inference API with average latency under 900 milliseconds.

projects.title: LLM Evaluation & Red-Teaming Framework
projects.short_description: An automated evaluation framework for measuring hallucination, bias, failure modes, and unsafe behavior in LLM responses.
highlights: Built an evaluation workflow 'reliability-observatory' with DeepEval and LangSmith for repeatable LLM quality and safety testing.
Created more than 500 adversarial prompts across six failure categories.
Identified a 23% hallucination rate on edge cases and used targeted fine-tuning to reduce violations by 61%.

projects.title: Multimodal Image + Text Classifier
projects.short_description: A CLIP-based multimodal classification system that combines image and text signals to categorize product listings and flag low-quality content.
highlights: The plan is to train and evaluate the classifier on up to 100,000 product listings, targeting 89% classification accuracy.
The proposed architecture combines visual and textual representations to improve product categorization.
The target outcome is to reduce manual tagging effort and flag low-quality listings more quickly.
projects.status_note: The imagery and project details reflect the current plan, not a finished product. The production version may differ as development continues.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.short_description: An AI/ML-first recruiter portfolio that also surfaces data analytics evidence through a grounded assistant and role-aware project discovery.
highlights: Built a responsive, accessible interface with React, TypeScript, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS, dark mode, project filters, and role-specific resume access.
Connected a FastAPI backend to a Hugging Face-hosted Qwen assistant with audited portfolio retrieval, streamed responses, and evidence-based recruiter matching.
Presents AI/ML work first while keeping SQL, dashboard, and analytics evidence easy for Data Analyst recruiters to find.
